expected.behavior: Discard the empty, truncated, null, and wrong-schema votes without guessing their content; 1 valid vote of 5 is no majority; fail closed to the keyword matcher and label the result as keyword fallback — it must NEVER be presented as a k=5 majority verdict.

expected.notes: The matcherFixture supplies a degenerate vote round: one valid vote, one empty output, one truncated JSON, one literal null, one fake alternative schema. Expected behavior per contract section 6.3: majority semantics are inherited unchanged, malformed votes are discarded not repaired, and the scoring fails closed to the honestly-labeled keyword fallback — here the keyword match legitimately finds u0, but the result metadata must say keyword fallback, never majority.
